jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Azure)
jobs.description:
Remuneration Package: Up to $9,000
Position: Permanent Role with Attractive Variable Bonus
Working Location: Central near MRT Station
Key Requirements: Experiences in web application development using .NET frameworks and familiar with Vue.js, Angular or React

We are assisting our client, an established international shipping organisation in hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer. With a global presence, the company connects regional ports to major shipping hubs and supports the movement of cargo across international markets.

This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on developer who enjoys solving technical challenges, building reliable applications and collaborating with an international team.

Why Join?

Attractive basic salary of S$9,000 per month.
Permanent opportunity with an established global maritime organisation.
Exposure to web development, modern frontend frameworks and Azure.
Contribute to application development and continuous improvement supporting shipping operations.

Key Responsibilities

Analyse business requirements and translate them into application features and technical solutions.
Write high-quality, maintainable code in line with development best practices and project timelines.
Develop new product features and improve existing applications.
Debug and troubleshoot application issues to support reliable system performance.
Conduct and support functional and non-functional testing before release.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation and user handbooks.
Collaborate with the software delivery team within an Agile Scrum environment.

Key Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in web application development using .NET frameworks.
Minimum 2 years of experience with modern frontend frameworks, such as Vue.js, Angular or React.
Experience with message queues such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS.
Experience with Azure, Git source control and Agile Scrum methodology.
Knowledge of parallel programming, optimisation and microservices will be an advantage.
Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
A collaborative, responsible and self-motivated approach, with the ability to work independently.

Interested candidates can forward their CVs in MS Word format to weiyan@triton-ai.com

jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Unified Content Processing Platform
jobs.description:
Description

Deliver AI Innovation in Compliance at Amazon

Join a team building the future of automated compliance in the product space. Your work will directly impact Amazon's ability to serve customers and partners safely and efficiently across the globe.

We have a unique challenge to overcome: use ML and LLMs at the scale of Amazon. As a software development engineer you will develop scalable LLM infrastructure that can be used to process billions of documents and images each year, in a cost efficient way.

The ideal candidate will be eager to work in a team of innovators and contribute to a suite of tools that power automating and scalable content processing with the end goal of providing Amazon shoppers and sellers with a frictionless and trustworthy shopping and selling experience. You will be working in an Agile mode, collaborating with product management and partner teams to iterate at a fast pace and delight our end users.

Key job responsibilities

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

designing, developing and maintaining distributed systems hosted in AWS;
guiding a team of engineers in writing maintainable code and adhering to operational practices;
defining idiomatic solutions for processing varied types of content with diverse ML solutions and application integrations;
improving performance and operational costs;
researching solutions for technically ambiguous problems.

A day in the life

As senior software engineer’s day typically involves designing or researching technical solutions and alternatives to your team’s most critical and complex features and projects. As a team leader, you will also review your peers’ code and dive deep into their design documents to provide feedback on software architecture, scalability and security. You will code the critical code path in your projects and coordinate with peers on the tasks that you delegated to them. You advise your manager on trade-offs and product future direction.

About The Team

Compliance Safety Services (CoSS) vision is to provide best-in-class automation of controls for internal compliance and business programs (our primary customers) to lower costs in the Amazon flywheel on behalf of our end customers: buyers and selling partners. We provide easy-to-use shared services with data privacy, security and tenant isolation across all stages, while continuously raising industry standards for automation performance and cost efficiency, giving our program customers confidence that they have access to optimal cost-efficient automation options to better serve their end customers.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (.NET / Backend Ağırlıklı)
jobs.description:
Full Stack Developer (.NET / Backend Ağırlıklı)

📍 Çanakkale | Ofisten | Tam Zamanlı

Sigorta teknolojileri alanında faaliyet gösteren ekibimize, backend geliştirme tarafı güçlü, mikroservis mimarilerine hakim ve gerektiğinde frontend geliştirmelerine de katkı sağlayabilecek Full Stack Developer arıyoruz.

Pozisyon ağırlıklı olarak; sigorta şirketleriyle yapılan entegrasyonlar, API servisleri, mikroservisler, veri tabanı işlemleri ve yüksek erişilebilirliğe sahip backend sistemlerinin geliştirilmesini kapsamaktadır.

Aradığımız Teknik Yetkinlikler
C# / .NET / ASP.NET Core konusunda güçlü bilgi
Mikroservis mimarileri konusunda deneyim
RESTful API geliştirme ve üçüncü parti servis entegrasyonları
HTTP, JSON, Authentication / Authorization ve JWT konularına hakimiyet
Async/Await, Dependency Injection, OOP ve SOLID prensipleri
MS SQL Server ve güçlü SQL bilgisi
Entity Framework veya benzeri ORM araçlarında deneyim
Git kullanımına hakimiyet
JavaScript / TypeScript bilgisi
Vue.js, React veya benzeri bir frontend frameworkü ile çalışma deneyimi
Tercih Sebebi Olacak Yetkinlikler
Docker ve container mimarileri
Redis / caching sistemleri
API Gateway yapıları
Message Queue teknolojileri (RabbitMQ, Kafka vb.)
CI/CD süreçleri
IIS ve production ortamlarında uygulama yönetimi
Distributed system ve servisler arası iletişim konusunda bilgi
Logging, monitoring ve performans optimizasyonu
Selenium / Playwright veya RPA teknolojileri
Sigorta, finans veya InsurTech sektöründe deneyim
Sorumluluklar
.NET tabanlı mikroservis ve API'ler geliştirmek
Sigorta şirketleri ve üçüncü parti servislerle entegrasyonlar geliştirmek
Mevcut servislerin bakımını, optimizasyonunu ve hata analizini yapmak
SQL sorguları ve veri erişim katmanlarını geliştirmek
Backend ağırlıklı olmak üzere frontend geliştirmelerine katkı sağlamak
Production ortamındaki teknik problemlerin kök neden analizlerini gerçekleştirmek
Ölçeklenebilir, sürdürülebilir ve temiz kod geliştirmek
Aradığımız Profil

Önceliğimiz:

Backend → Mikroservis → API Entegrasyonları → Database → Frontend

Backend tarafında güçlü, sistemin bütününü anlayabilen, debugging ve problem çözme becerisi yüksek, yalnızca kod yazmak yerine servislerin nasıl haberleştiğini ve sistemin nasıl ölçekleneceğini düşünebilen geliştiricilerle çalışmak istiyoruz.

📍 Çalışma Yeri: Çanakkale
🏢 Çalışma Modeli: Ofisten
🕒 Çalışma Tipi: Tam Zamanlı

En az 5 yıl deneyim şartı aranmaktadır. Remote veya hibrit çalışma modeli bulunmamaktadır. Adayın Çanakkale'de ofisten çalışabilecek olması beklenmektedir.

jobs.title: Senior  C# / .NET Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lohn - CHF110'000 - 130'000

Digitale Lösungen für Sozialversicherungen entwickeln – klingt das nach Deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Unser Rocken Partner zählt zu den führenden Anbietern von Softwarelösungen für Ausgleichskassen und Pensionskassen. Mit etablierten Produkten und innovativen SaaS-Angeboten gestaltet das Unternehmen die digitale Transformation einer ganzen Branche aktiv mit. Im Mittelpunkt stehen massgeschneiderte Entwicklungen, zuverlässiger Support und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung komplexer Fachapplikationen. Das Tätigkeitsfeld reicht von der Softwareentwicklung über Beratung und Einführung bis hin zu Wartung und Schulung. Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit prägen den Alltag. Das Unternehmen setzt auf langfristige Perspektiven und fördert gezielt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung seiner Mitarbeitenden. Bereit, an Lösungen zu arbeiten, die wirklich einen Unterschied machen? Der Rocken Partner freut sich auf Deine Bewerbung!

Rolle

Du suchst nach einer neuen Herausforderung als Senior Softwareentwickler:in .NET/C# mit professionellem Erfahrungslevel. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung innovativer Softwarelösungen. Du verantwortest die Erstellung von hochwertigen Lösungen, die einen nachhaltigen Beitrag leisten. Durch deine Arbeit leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur sozialen Vorsorge. Du wirst Teil eines Teams sein, das auf Teamgeist, Respekt und Wertschätzung basiert.

Verantwortung

Du entwickelst und wartest komplexe Web-Applikationen auf Basis von .NET/C# und Microsoft SQL Server
In dieser Rolle arbeitest du meist in unterschiedlichen Projekten eingebettet in Scrum Teams
Als Senior Softwareentwickler unterstützt du unsere Lösungsarchitekten und Projektleiter vom Lösungskonzept bis hin zur Abnahme
Du stehst unseren Produktberatern bei Problemstellungen unserer Kunden zur Seite
Du leistest mit Code-Reviews und Unit-Tests einen wichtigen Beitrag an unsere Softwarequalität
In deiner Funktion triffst du Entscheidungen über die technische Umsetzung von Projekten

Qualifikationen

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik oder Technik.
Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit.
Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit den Kerntechnologien .NET/C# und Microsoft SQL Server.
Du arbeitest selbständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert.
Du hast Freude am Arbeiten in Teams und an agiler Vorgehensweise.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Benefits

Beteiligung an gesundheitlichen Massnahmen
Beteiligung oder Übernahme beim Handy und Notebook
Homeoffice
Beteiligung oder Übernahme ÖV-Abonnements
Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
